data.title: Damac Bay 2
data.about:
At Damac Bay 2 by Cavalli, a stunning oceanfront property created for people seeking the ultimate lifestyle experience, explore a world of luxury living by the sea. Damac Bay Phase 2 at Dubai Harbour features 1 to 3-bedroom apartments and ultra-luxury 3 to 5-bedroom apartments, each featuring unmatched excellent beach views, available at this lovely branded property by the well-known Italian fashion designer. The stunning towers are the project of DAMAC Properties.

Dubai Harbour is the most distinctive and active neighborhood in the area, providing residents with privileged beach access as well as a variety of interesting amenities and activities. It is situated at the junction of Bluewaters and the renowned Palm Jumeirah.

characteristics_module.title: Luxury Becomes Second Nature
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• DAMAC Bay 2, Where Luxury Becomes Second Nature
  • Exclusive, direct access to pristine sands, offering unparalleled beachside living and privacy.
  • Luxurious Cavalli-branded interiors, epitomizing style and sophistication.
  • Stunning, panoramic vistas of the marina and skyline, enhancing the living experience.
  • Discover the newest Roberto Cavalli styles at the Cavalli Museum.
  • From floating relaxation pods and glamping tents, where you can indulge in beauty and body treatments.
  • Lounge in the pool while sipping your favorite mocktail, experiencing the ultimate luxury at DAMAC Bay 2.

location_tile.title: Find Your Wat to Dubai Harbour
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Damac bay by Cavalli is in an unparalleled waterfront community located at the crossroads of the renowned Palm Jumeirah and Bluewaters Island. Conveniently positioned between Dubai International Airport and Al Maktoum International Airport, this extraordinary neighborhood is surrounded by the city’s most beloved landmarks, stunning beaches, and world-famous attractions such as the Ain Dubai and Burj Al Arab. With its unique backdrop, iconic vistas, and convenient location, Dubai Harbour is a lifestyle destination offering a wide range of living, retail, and hospitality options and comprehensive berthing facilities.

Nearby attractions:

10 Minutes to Dubai Marina Mall
10 Minutes to Palm Jumeirah
12 Minutes to Ibn Battuta Mall
15 Minutes to the Mall of the Emirates
